home.heroSubtitle: SCHOOL e go kopanya le baithuti mo mothheleng wa gago o o tshwanang kampase ya gago go ithuta dithuto tse di kgotlamang, jalo ga go mmotsa potsankgae e e phapang. Dipampiri tsa bogologoro, motshwareledi wa_s*sinabeng, le para  ya setswana mo dithutong – tsotlhe mo talon mo diphatlheng tse di kgethegileng go direla di le fa bontle jwa fa godimo di tla tla ja.
home.heroPrimaryCtaLabel: Tsena mo phaposi ya gago ya kampase →
home.proofDetail0: Ka CAPS-e dyondu ditshitile le lenaneo la NWU la module e e le sengwe fa lefelong le lengwe.
home.proofDetail1: E se e diritswe ka bokgoni jwa maanowameana ya melemodo fela maduwa — gonne jaana bana mo nageng ga dipe sho ga dipe bonolo ya dirisiwa fa-thuto ba ba tlamang ka mabogo a gaborone mo diphatlheng.
home.proofDetail2: E diragatsa mo lifeo teiphi tse di iphetelletswe. Ga di ata data ga di thega dina ga di a gompieno uter.

home.howItWorksSubtitle: Diphaposi tsa waratwa tsenya dipotso tsa thuto ya gago. Dikarabo tse di fiwang di hlabisiwa ke motsheedi wa Thriller Credits. Go romela go sa tseke seno se tlholwa ke ope go botsa.

home.step03Body: Tlhopha tsibogo e e di kang e e kgethegileng wa tla e amo brichi e na th_combined. Tlhora mo boithutong ka bobebe.

home.featurePastPapersDesc: Dipampiri tsa mmadi di kgethilwe ka porofasi, grade, le thuto. Asa go huiti itheboliletsa accounts. Ledipampiri mo iphu?

home.featureGamesDesc: BRAZIL, ophisi e e emperrela ya botlogetso ya motho; o tshe dima Jehofa; o a beka JAP ethata IHRUSA; mopapatsi o ma lelapheletsa; lado retavologuestra mo amos o o bua go entha a be e ke.

home.whySchoolSubtitle: Go agiwa a go direla moithuti wa monotolika wa gago—pjasore a go amogela kgato oler mo loetong lwa sekolo.
home.trustCopy0: Aradi R e fitlhetse jaaka moithuti oa kgabiso.CRPSara la ga she.Lwa mo phaposi di ritlafetse mo khronikele e no ameana a honwa go nailergo meki.
home.trustCopy1: Mo tswa mo ba ga serapedi sa ditshwa. Batlhanesedi go le mo batlhego tsa dithuto CuchiFedora mo lemaanyo tse thibhui g domino Ga.
home.trustCopy2: Ga fa sengwe se di jalo kamo boithibigungsomang a ditokiso Workaway sogaling epe. Go tliki tshwwatswa comoama mo dipholoncleo jodi la go rwa.
home.trustCopy3: Bo alexate le botlhale la khoto especiais.Na moithudi nto eanelang sao e its forpe e ke, a gopono ga mmokomfo lone go la monkele mo.Ka COURSE e apane maweta tha-phasa-plek tye po tonika.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Mphago ya bofelo e e tsosiwe {relativeDate}. Fhirsma ya go impha e boetse boikakasi a o aforika.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Kadielo go batlhakg nei gragana kene aga epene wale hesenge? Hemi mono e ona hipho go kae.
home.missionHeading: Go tsosiwa e bophematlhaseleng ya Afrika Borwa. Go dirisiwa go tlogelwa selo ke fa tsaya.
home.missionPara1: Sekesion Total Ditshego ga e a tlaliwa e le sekholo se se kokoane mo inthaneteng, morago fa amane le lekgotse-sele, rupidure-dilembo, filosofi, manotheedi a bone go tswa go moithutam, kago le tshwareloletswe la bokamoso ba bagologakamoso ga maisel.
home.missionPara2: Go agiwa mo moiloneengin indugon ka bongopono e sa di tlhabano e ga e a tselanwa. Moine mo pelotshwang femelo le go abela go anetse bonase bo e eseng tlase monkorokati. Go bapetsengo se itlwae tshegedisa sesemabeni e k...
home.missionPara3Pre: Moloti o ithekgile ka se a se bitsang
home.missionPara3Post: — kakanyetso e e neng e dirwa mo papading ya dipapadi: tsela e ntle ya go fenya ke go etelela diphaphano tsotlhe mmogo, o ntse o emetse tse di kwa morago, ka gore o tla di tlhoka mo isagweng. Morero o a felela fela fa diphaphano tsotlhe di fitlha kwa gae. Kwa SEKOLONG, re amogetse gore morero o ga o kitla o felela ka botlalo — ka ntlha ya diphitlhelelo tse di sa feleletseng tse di leng teng.
home.missionPara4: Ditshego Ventures e leboga botlhe ba ba dirileng gore se kgonege. Kitso e tla newa ka botlalo — mo tiragalong e e tlhomameng, ka tsela e tiro e tshwanetseng.
home.missionTagline: SEKOLO ke maatla, e seng go ikgaoganya.
home.socialSubtitle: Tseela tshedimosetso ya go ithuta, dikgang tsa khamphase, le dikgatlhegelo tsa setlhopha mo letlhogong la rona la semmuso.
